# BYZ scope. The colonisation line's points of posts (oe_col_posts_n; suspended posts do not count).

    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_posts_n } value = var:oe_col_posts_n }
}

# BYZ scope. The year's gross profit P (design 3.6 step 2): 1.0 month of income a point; Caffa's post, suspended by the colonisation line while Caffa is at war (oe_crm_caffa_war), earns 0.5 of its points; the farmed customs (.3) add 2 months. Phase 2: a point of a Levant post earns 1.5 (its 1.0 is in the points already; read from the site, so it works before the colonisation line's SITES hook too), and every bought location the empire still holds 0.5 (oe_cmp_land_held, counted in January).
oe_cmp_gross = {
    value = oe_cmp_pts
    multiply = oe_fin_month
    multiply = 1.0
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_crm_caffa_war
            has_variable = oe_col_post_kaffa
            var:oe_col_post_kaffa >= 1
            location:kaffa = { has_variable = oe_col_post has_variable = oe_col_post_susp }
        }
        add = { value = var:oe_col_post_kaffa multiply = oe_fin_month multiply = 0.5 }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_farm } add = { value = oe_fin_month multiply = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { location:famagusta = { oe_col_post_counts = yes } }
        add = { value = location:famagusta.var:oe_col_post multiply = oe_fin_month multiply = 0.5 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:alexandria = { oe_col_post_counts = yes } }
        add = { value = location:alexandria.var:oe_col_post multiply = oe_fin_month multiply = 0.5 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:beirut = { oe_col_post_counts = yes } }
        add = { value = location:beirut.var:oe_col_post multiply = oe_fin_month multiply = 0.5 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_land_held }
        add = { value = var:oe_cmp_land_held multiply = oe_fin_month multiply = 0.5 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Autonomy a year (design 3.4): b + 2 + points; c the same x 1.5; a none.

        add = 2

    }
}

# Location scope (the land or the quarter asked for). The chance in percent that its owner agrees (design 3.9 ACCEPT; the AI owner rolls it in oe_cmp.11).
oe_cmp_acc_land = {
    value = 20
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= -75 } } } add = 5 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= -50 } } } add = 5 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= -25 } } } add = 5 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 0 } } } add = 5 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 25 } } } add = 5 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 50 } } } add = 5 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 75 } } } add = 5 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 100 } } } add = 5 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { has_variable = oe_cmp_prot } } add = 20 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { at_war = yes } } add = 15 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { gold < oe_fin_m12 } } add = 10 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { is_rival_of = c:BYZ } } add = -100 }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { location_rank = location_rank:city location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis } }
        add = -20
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            c:BYZ = { var:oe_cmp_holder ?= 3 var:oe_cmp_partner ?= 1 }
            OR = { this = location:kaffa this = location:tana owner ?= { oe_col_genoese = yes } }
        }
        add = 15
    }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TRE country_exists = c:TRE c:TRE = { var:oe_tre_genoa ?= 2 } } add = 10 }
    min = 5
    max = 90
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_cmp_land saved. The price of that target: a quarter, or land by its rank.
oe_cmp_price = {
    value = oe_cmp_price_q
    if = {
        limit = {
            scope:oe_cmp_land = { NOT = { oe_cmp_tgt_q = yes } location_rank = location_rank:rural_settlement }
        }
        value = oe_cmp_price_rural_settlement
    }
    if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_cmp_land = { NOT = { oe_cmp_tgt_q = yes } location_rank = location_rank:town } }
        value = oe_cmp_price_town
    }
    if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_cmp_land = { NOT = { oe_cmp_tgt_q = yes } location_rank = location_rank:city } }
        value = oe_cmp_price_city
    }
    if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_cmp_land = { NOT = { oe_cmp_tgt_q = yes } location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis } }
        value = oe_cmp_price_megalopolis
    }
}

# Location scope. The AI's order of targets (design 3.7): the owner's chance, + 40 a site itself, + 10 a town.
oe_cmp_ai_score = {
    value = oe_cmp_acc_land
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                this = location:tana
                this = location:kaffa
                this = location:trebizond
                this = location:sinop
                this = location:varna
                this = location:chilia
                this = location:famagusta
                this = location:alexandria
                this = location:beirut
            }
        }
        add = 40
    }
    if = { limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town } add = 10 }
}
